decision: The step's order: plugins/overnight/domain/scripts/resume moves to its new place before dev/overnight/tests/unit goes up again, or the two, with pyproject.toml's coverage include and dev/scripts/check.sh's pyrefly paths, go up in one put-up. Why: the mend is one line of dev/overnight/tests/unit/conftest.py, SCRIPTS = os.path.join(TOP, "plugins", "overnight", "scripts") becoming os.path.join(TOP, "plugins", "overnight", "domain", "scripts"), with its docstring following, as the decision that the tests "reach resume at its new place" asks. But plugins/overnight/domain/ doesn't exist yet in the worktree (resume still lies at plugins/overnight/scripts/resume), so with that mend every case fails at `import resume`, and the pre-push check, which runs these tests, refuses the put-up. The tests can't both point at the new place and pass while resume is at the old one, short of pointing at both places, which keeps a path no decision holds. So the tests come after or with the move, which changes the step's order of deliverables.
